newsitem.title: USA: Quad Systems sees Q3 EPS below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Quad Systems sees Q3 EPS below estimates.

text.p: Quad Systems Corp said on Monday that it expects to report earnings per share for the third quarter in the range of $0.02 to $0.03, well below the Wall Street analyst estimate of $0.20.
The company said in a news release it reduced its workforceaaa about 13 percent in response to bookings problems.
Net sales for the period were expected to be in the range of $16 million to $17 million, while analysts were expecting about $22 million, the company said.
Quad Systems blamed the disappointing results on below-plan bookings and to the fact that some bookings for the quarter were not available for delivery until future quarters.
Also, some bookings expected late in the quarter were delayed.
The company makes assembly equipment systems for production lines.
